mentions.author: John Fryer
mentions.note: Physiology was not taught at school, but reading the woodblock-printed Quanti Xinlun and Huaxue Weisheng Lun, we learned ever more clearly that Chinese medicine was nothing but conscious or unconscious deception.*

mentions.author: Xiahou Xuan
mentions.note: They say that before leaving home she had copied out a thousand Amida Sutras, and had practised her hand with the Treatise on Yue Yi and, earlier still, the Gangoji Engi written by her elder brother.*

mentions.author: Higuchi Ichiyō
mentions.note: On the large magnolia-wood desk beneath the lamp, the Myōjō, Bungei Club, the Man'yōshū and the Ichiyō Zenshū lay scattered in disorder.*
